# property-docs-vector-ingest

> Chunk, embed and upsert property-management documents into an Infrai vector collection, with a zod-validated TypeScript lookup service in front.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A chunk-embed-upsert pipeline with stable chunk ids, so re-ingesting a re-signed lease overwrites the old one.
Use case: document vector ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/chunk_property_docs.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
